parallel_full_row.acip: NYAN RANG DGRA BCOM PA CHOS CAN, PHYI ROL PA BZHIN DU KHAMS GSUM NA SPYOD PA'I PHRA RGYAS THAMS CAD MA SPANGS PAR THAL, DE THAMS CAD KYI RTZA BAR GYUR PA'I DNGOS PO RANG BZHIN GYIS GRUB PAR 'DZIN PA'I RTOG PA DANG 'DZIN STANGS DNGOS 'GAL DU ZHUGS PA'I LAM MA RNYED PA'I PHYIR, DER THAL, DNGOS PO RANG BZHIN MED PAR YONGS SU SHES PA DANG BRAL BA'I PHYIR,
parallel_full_row.wylie: nyan rang dgra bcom pa chos can, phyi rol pa bzhin du khams gsum na spyod pa'i phra rgyas thams cad ma spangs par thal, de thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i dngos po rang bzhin gyis grub par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang 'dzin stangs dngos 'gal du zhugs pa'i lam ma rnyed pa'i phyir, der thal, dngos po rang bzhin med par yongs su shes pa dang bral ba'i phyir
parallel_full_row.english: Let us first consider enemy destroyers of the Listener or Self-Made Buddha type. Aren't you saying then that, like the non-Buddhists, they fail to eliminate all the widespread mental afflictions that operate in all three realms? Because isn't it true that they have failed to achieve the path which is directly incompatible, in the way it holds its object, with the root of all these afflictions; that is, the tendency to conceive of things as existing through some nature of their own? And this is true, for they lack that comprehensive knowledge where they realize that things have no nature of their own.
